title: UFOs seen cleaning up radiation at Fukushima and Chernobyl

tellings.quote: And in both cases, people see the UFOs come down and seemingly clean up the radiation.

plain: At both the Chernobyl nuclear disaster in Ukraine in 1986 and the Fukushima disaster in Japan in 2011, people saw UFOs come down and seemingly clean up the radiation, Michels says. He tells this to the magician and UFO enthusiast Chris Ramsay, pointing to a researcher named Jensine Andresen. If true, it would suggest whatever is behind the UFOs watches over, and even protects, humanity.
